meta.topic: Health and travel gaps: named providers' self-pay prices, claim denials and appeals, chronic follow-up intervals, accessible taxis, primary-care waits (Ireland, Mexico), airline bags, connections and change fees, rideshare, hotel extras, child travel
meta.method: Publisher pages fetched directly (curl or WebFetch) and the quoted text read; where the publisher blocked the fetch (403/JS-only), the figure comes from a WebSearch summary and is marked confirmed:false with a note. Nothing estimated. Existing files were checked first to avoid repeats: research-health-visits.json, research-travel-2.json, research-travel4.json, research-travel-insurance-referrals.json, research-access-availability.json, research-hotel-amenities.json. Where a topic is already covered there, this file points to it instead of repeating it.

providers.name: 209 NYC Dental
providers.address: 209 East 56th Street, 1st Floor, New York, NY 10022

providers.name: Warby Parker (eye exams, US stores including New York City)
providers.note: Booking page: 'Glasses exam $95*' (20-30 min); 'Glasses and contacts exam $150-$170*'; '*Exam prices vary depending on location. Payment is due at the time of the exam.' A Grand Central figure of 'from $85' appeared only in a search summary and was not confirmed. National page, so it also applies to Warby Parker stores in Los Angeles; no New Haven store was confirmed.

accessibleTransport.service: Accessible yellow/green taxi via TLC-licensed E-hail apps (replaced Accessible Dispatch)

figures.fare: standard meter on street hail; app companies may quote an upfront price

accessibleTransport.note: TLC (https://www.nyc.gov/site/tlc/about/accessible-dispatch.page, read): 'Accessible Dispatch is now Accessible Taxi E-hail. MTM Accessible Dispatch's last day of service is February 28, 2026.' E-hail apps named: Arro, Curb, Myle. 'street hail trips use the meter'. Taxi meter rates are in research-travel-2.json; fleet share in research-access-availability.json. The old 'no extra cost' wording appeared only in search summaries.

Already covered there: all London black cabs wheelchair accessible (TfL 2025 action plan); LA Access Services $2.75 under 20 mi / $3.50 at 20+ mi; Toronto about 10 active on-demand WAV taxis (City 2024 review); Metro Vancouver 370 of 1,952 taxis accessible (PTB 2017). Not repeated here.

waits.system: IMSS first level (Unidades de Medicina Familiar), ENCAL 2025
waits.note: National survey (262 UMFs, Oct-Nov 2025), not CDMX-specific. '29 días promedio entre solicitud de cita y atención'; '76% de usuarios espera 2 semanas o más'. 31% also used care outside IMSS in the past year (60% private doctor, 25% pharmacy-adjacent consultorios).

Read directly from the PDF. This confirms the 61-day figure that research-health-visits.json held as search-summary only. The page layout also prints '76 min' beside triage; the text paragraph says 82 min mean, 30 min median.
Irish Examiner / Ipsos B&A 'Rural Ireland Thinks' survey, published 2026-09-18. Rural respondents only; Dublin itself is excluded. The HSE publishes no GP waiting-time statistic.

airlineBags.note: First/second bag fees from https://www.delta.com/us/en/baggage/overview (read). This confirms the Delta fee research-travel-2.json held as secondary.
The page says fees are accurate as of 2024-10-28; the 2026 first-bag fees are in research-travel-2.json. Overweight and oversize together is a single fee.

The Ryanair page (read) confirms the 10/20/23 kg allowances, per-kilo excess charged at the airport and the 32 kg cap; the money figures come from search summaries of Ryanair's fees page (JS-rendered, not readable).
jetblue.com pages render by JavaScript; figures from secondary search summaries. 2026 increases not confirmed.
westjet.com returned 404 for the checked-bag URL; figures from secondary aggregators.
